text: I hold OPPOSE. entry 116.84 against ma_200 67.78 puts price more than 70% above the 200-day: a C24 climax reading, sold into, never bought (R7, a rule I hold firm on). The ticket meets no clearing condition I named: no base has formed (ABOVE_STRUCTURE, coil warn, R3) and price is still past the 70% line. My answer to the hold: timing moves to WAIT, not ACT_NOW. What would clear my objection: a base forming with price back under 70% above ma_200, then a pivot breakout on volume at least 1.4x normal (C16). A first pullback inside a climax run is not that base.
